answer: Submitting an answer locks 12 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The river escrow is released only against a prism receipt, and the orchard audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 124 aliases means carrying 213 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
